package.description: 面向科研写作、数据分析和工程任务的桌面 Agent 工作台，把 Agent、文件、编辑器和工作流放回同一个任务现场。

en-US.description: Open-source AI research workspace built with Electron and FastAPI, featuring provider-neutral agent workflows for DeepSeek, GLM, and other OpenAI-compatible models.
en-US.longDescription: ArHub (AI Research Hub) is a desktop agent workbench for research writing, data analysis, and engineering tasks, built with Electron, FastAPI, OpenAI-compatible model interfaces, and extensible Skill workflows, supporting DeepSeek, GLM, and other OpenAI-compatible models. ArHub does not confine agents to an isolated chat box: day-to-day operations stay conversation-centric, and when a task touches files, code, or other artifacts, the file tree, editor, and preview expand on demand in the current workspace. Execution steps, checkpoints, logs, and artifacts persist with the task so you can resume, review, and audit later.

zh-CN.description: 面向科研写作、数据分析和工程任务的桌面 Agent 工作台，把 Agent、文件、编辑器和工作流放回同一个任务现场。
zh-CN.longDescription: ArHub（AI Research Hub）是一个面向科研写作、数据分析和工程任务的桌面 Agent 工作台，基于 Electron、FastAPI、OpenAI-compatible 模型接口和可扩展 Skill 工作流构建，支持 DeepSeek、GLM 等 OpenAI 兼容模型。ArHub 不把 Agent 限制在孤立的聊天框里：日常操作以对话为中心；当任务涉及文件、代码或其他产物时，文件树、编辑器和预览会在当前工作区按需展开。执行步骤、检查点、日志和产物会随任务持久化，方便继续运行、回看和审阅。
zh-CN.name: ArHub
